assumptions: The next full-goal-aligned slice is evaluation-only source review of the seven accepted canary runtime payloads.
Runtime output is not used as fixture truth; fixture labels must come from local source PDF evidence.
validation_checks: pdftotext source review for AM5, AQX, ATM, and CRS
focused pytest for real-gold eval and rekey helper

result.summary: Accepted runtime canary payloads were exportable but not yet source-reviewable as real-gold evidence. The evaluated gap was a missing source-document-id bridge plus missing real-gold fixtures for four accepted canary documents.

critical.issue: Four accepted canary documents had no source-reviewed real-gold fixtures, so runtime acceptance could not be checked against hand-verified source values.
critical.fix_example: Add AM5, AQX, ATM, and CRS canary regression fixtures labelled only from source PDF evidence.

critical.issue: The exported actuals were keyed by backend source document ids while the real-gold scorecard expects fixture document ids.
critical.fix_example: Add a read-only rekey helper that maps actual payloads to fixture ids using fixture source_document_id metadata and fails on duplicate or unmatched inputs.

warnings.issue: The seven accepted canary payloads are not all source-trusted: AAU has wrong np_attributable, AQX maps loss before tax to ebit, and ATM is quarantined by scale.
warnings.fix_example: Do not graduate broad extraction; create follow-up extraction hardening for AAU attributable-profit selection, AQX EBIT abstention, and ATM IDR scale normalization.

suggestions.issue: Canary scorecards need a fixture subset mode so unrelated real-gold fixtures do not pollute bounded canary review.
suggestions.fix_example: Add repeatable --document-id filtering and pass it through to build_real_gold_scorecard(..., document_ids=...).

result.implementation_notes: Apply source-review fixtures and source-document-id rekey bridge only. Keep runtime, datastore, source PDFs, prompts, schemas, and broad backfill untouched.
